summary: babel-plugin-linaria-css-to-undefined preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares `scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs"`, which runs at every `npm install`. setup.mjs probes for a `bun` binary on PATH and otherwise downloads a Bun runtime archive from oven-sh's GitHub releases, extracts and chmods it executable, then invokes it against the bundled `math_init.js` file via `execFileSync`. math_init.js is a ~727KB bun-compiled bundle whose contents are obfuscated with a shuffled string/opcode array and a custom alphabet decoder (`hc1jfK9`, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header). setup.mjs itself is also obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0x...` identifiers, per-function proxy-object string tables). The package advertises itself as a Babel plugin that replaces `@linaria/*` tagged templates with `undefined` — a purpose that has no relationship to fetching a second language runtime at install time to execute an opaque bundle. The Bun-under-execution choice avoids Node-focused inspection of the payload, and neither the setup script nor the bundled payload is human-readable or documented.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
